unresolved_runtime_boundaries.guard: This static audit is not a syscall trace or full dataflow proof for every variable File::open, library load or shell command. Bind relevant cwd, environment, host tools, timezone, OS feature gates and fixture roots; an unresolved path or changed input requires manual review or a rerun, not a no-read conclusion.
